newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: SOCCER-SAVICEVIC REPORTED KEEN ON MANCHESTER UNITED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SAVICEVIC REPORTED KEEN ON MANCHESTER UNITED.

text.p: AC Milan's Yugoslav striker Dejan Savicevic said on Monday he had still not decided where to continue his career, "but that the most favourable option at the moment is a move to Manchester United next autumn."

With his contract at Milan nearing an end, he told the daily newspaper Pobjeda: "Milan will naturally endeavour to get the best possible price for me and the best possible return on its investment in me."
He said he had received offers from many clubs, including Monaco. The latest had come from Japan.
"The decision on my future career rests with me and me only and all reports which have appeared in the Yugoslav and other media in that context are totally unfounded," said Savicevic.
Savicevic, a talented striker, was the inspiration behind Milan's 4-0 thrashing of Barcelona in the 1994 European Cup final.
